scenarios.grader_notes: The CO check was asked once, the oven question was handled without a lecture, and the booking was confirmed, but there were several clunky lines, such as the doubled "let me read back / let me read that back" and the awkward approver and name question. The agent also asked "Can I get the name for the booking?" right after Rosa had given her name and said bye, which ignored what she said and dragged out the call.

transcript.text: Thanks for calling Summit Air, this is the virtual assistant. How can I help?
hi um my boiler quit last night so we've had the oven on with the door open to keep warm
Just to be safe, is a carbon monoxide alarm going off, or is anyone feeling sick or dizzy?
no um no alarm going off the carbon monoxide detector in the hallway is quiet my son and i both feel fine nobody's dizzy or anything
Okay, I'm glad you're both feeling fine. Please don't use the oven to heat the house, though. Let's get someone out to you. What's the address?
it's two one four oh bath ave brooklyn one one two one four
We do cover that area. I don't have an account for that address yet, so I'll take a few details. Is the house temperature inside something you can tell me, like what the thermostat reads?
it's about 58 degrees inside right now um i checked it a little while ago
Got it, 58 inside. What kind of system do you have, a boiler for radiators, and roughly how old is it?
it's a boiler the kind that heats the radiators i think i don't know how old it is um it was here when we moved in so a while
Okay, that's fine. Do you know the brand on the boiler, like Burnham, Weil-McLain, or Peerless? If not, that's okay too.
um i don't know the brand there's a metal plate on the front of it but i haven't looked closely i can go check if you need it
No need to check now, the technician can read it. Has anything been tried since it quit, like resetting it or checking the pilot or power switch?
i flipped the switch off and back on once um but it didn't come on i didn't mess with anything else
Thanks, that's helpful. Is it your place, or are you renting?
it's our house we own it my son and i live here
Got it, you own it. Who's at home with it right now? Anyone who'd have a harder time with the cold?
it's just me and my son he's an adult neither of us is sick or anything we're both healthy we're just cold and kind of annoyed about it
Understood, sorry you're both stuck in the cold. Anything the technician should know when they get there, like a gate code, a buzzer, or a dog?

no gate code there's no dog either um just the front door my son will be home to let them in or i can be there is it okay if we keep using the oven until the technician comes it's the only thing keeping the kitchen warm

I can't tell you to use the oven, since it can put carbon monoxide in the house. Try a few layers, blankets, and keeping the door to one room closed. Now let me look for a visit time. We have an opening today between 12 and 4, and tomorrow and Wednesday have openings too. Which works best for you?
oh okay i won't use the oven then um today between 12 and 4 works that's the first one you said my son can be there for it
Great. Before I book, let me read back the details. Let me read that back: your home at 2140 Bath Ave, Brooklyn, 11214, and the best number is 347, 555, 0178. Is that right?
yes um that's right two one four oh bath ave brooklyn one one two one four and three four seven five five five oh one seven eight
Who approves the work? Since you own the house, I'll note you as the approver. Is your name something I should put down?
yes it's rosa jimenez thank you um that's all i needed bye
Can I get the name for the booking?
rosa jimenez r o s a j i m e n e z
You're all set for today, with the technician arriving between 12 and 4. Your son can let them in at the front door. Anything else?
no that's everything thanks bye
Thanks for calling Summit Air. Stay warm out there.
